Bionic Changelog | LM Studio Changelog 👾 Bionic 1.1.1 Bionic 1.1.1 Significant UI performance improvements Fixed project Git branch details becoming stale after repository changes. New "Agent" section in App Settings Fixed moving a forked session also moving its parent session. Session status indicators on collapsed projects. localhost links can now open in App Browser or the system browser. Auto name session after forking and user message send More reliable agent use of available skills. New top bar icons and improved sidebar spacing. llama.cpp 2.31.2 extension packs. Fixed tabs reacting to drags from other windows. Fixed the composer losing focus after sending the first message from a new tab.
